title: String Quartet No. 14 · I. Adagio ma non troppo e molto espressivo
subtitle: Op. 131 · Selected subject entries

analysis.description: Ten selected substantial subject statements and transformed answers, checked against the ABC score and Ormesher's discussion. Includes the middle viola statement's altered continuation, the high A-major entry and the final cello augmentation. This is not an exhaustive map: false entries, subject fragments, episodic imitations and short stretti are omitted. Bounds are editorial selections measured in the score, not published recording times. The opening pickup and separate unnumbered closing bar retain their actual durations.
